chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abu al-Mi'za, from Abu Basir, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'One who frequently recites Surah Ha Mim al-Zukhruf, Allah will keep him safe in his grave from the crawling creatures of the earth and the pressure of the grave, until he stands before Allah, the Exalted and Mighty. Then it [the Surah] will come until it admits him to Paradise by the command of Allah, the Blessed and the High.'

key_terms.حَمِ الزُّخْرُفِ: Surah Ha Mim al-Zukhruf (Chapter 43 of the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for frequently reciting Surah al-Zukhruf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) highlights the spiritual efficacy of habitual recitation of Surah al-Zukhruf, promising protection from the trials of the grave (barzakh), specifically the pressure (daqat al-qabr) and its creatures. This narration underscores the intercessory role of the Quranic text itself, which, by divine command, facilitates the believer's entry into Paradise, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the tangible benefits of Quranic devotion in the intermediate realm.
